title: Moesha
description:
S5 E14 — Secrets and Lies
The arrival of Frank’s Aunt Hattie brings a shocking revelation about Frank that turns the rest of the family – especially Dorian and Moesha – against him.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E15 — Color Him Father
Still reeling from the news that Frank is Dorian’s biological father, the Mitchells prepare for Dorian’s 17th birthday bash, a party that grows more and more elaborate and expensive as Dorian takes full advantage of Frank’s guilt.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E16 — Family Affair
Still angry at Frank for keeping his true relationship to Dorian a secret for so long, Moesha decides not to introduce her father at an upcoming 'Businessman of the Year' awards banquet.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E17 — The Matchmaker
Hoping to boost the confidence of her new roommate, Theresa, Moesha asks Hakeem’s good-looking friend to ask Theresa on a date – but can’t leave well enough alone when the date is a success.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E18 — Gimme A Break
Moesha, Niecy, and Hakeem go to Santa Barbara for Spring Break. A campus rival spreads false information that Mo is 'easy' when her ex-boyfriend shows interest in Moesha.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E6 — Little Sister
Eddie is determined to keep Malcolm away from his younger sister.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E7 — Big Brother Is Watching
Eddie agrees to spend time with a ten-year-old boy in order to date a beautiful woman.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E8 — The Boy Who Cried Werewolf
Eddie fears a family curse will make him a werewolf on Halloween.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E9 — Dead Guy
After faking an injury in order to sue Malcolm and Eddie, an unruly customer suddenly dies in the kitchen.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E10 — Do The KC Hustle
An old college rival shows up at the bar looking to avenge a game of pool he lost to Malcolm.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E11 — It's The Bomb
Acting on a rumor that the local football team is moving, a crazed fan takes the bar hostage.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E14 — Fred & Carol & Fred & Donna
When Fred invites his fiancée Donna and a door-to-door saleslady to dinner on the same evening, Lamont is convulsed by his father's attempts to keep the women apart.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E15 — A Guest In The Yard
Fred and Lamont find a bum in their yard. The Sanfords are jumping to his every whim for fear he'll make good his threat. The uninvited guest claims Fred pushed him -- creating untold injuries -- and he's threatened to sue them for everything they own.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E16 — The Big Party
Faced with more bills than they can pay, Fred and Lamont decide to give a neighborhood party -- and charge admission. Everything goes well until two gangsters show up and make the Sanfords 'an offer they can't refuse.'.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E17 — Lamont Goes African
Fred thinks Lamont's fascinations with Africa are ludicrous, until he meets Olaiya, a Nigerian woman. Lamont adopts African dress and customs to impress Olaiya, but Lamont's lack of respect for his father interferes with his goal.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E18 — Watts Side Story
Fred is shocked when Lamont dates the sister of their Puerto Rican neighbor, Julio. The date becomes farcical when Fred's ploys to stop the date fail and he follows the couple -- in disguise.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E19 — Pops 'N Pals
Feeling jealous and neglected, Fred conjures up several ruses that will hopefully keep Lamont from spending so much time with Julio.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E20 — The Infernal Triangle
Lamont is upset when Fred announces that he plans to marry a young woman he has just met. When the young lady arrives at the house, Lamont is shocked to be face-to-face with one of his old girlfriends.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E21 — Home Sweet Home For The Aged
Fred is caught up in a series of frustrating situations when he becomes a resident of a senior citizens' home. Fred is put in the home by Lamont, who plans to work his way around the world on a tramp steamer and doesn't want to leave his father alone.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E5 — George's Legacy
If Napoleon and Lincoln could do it, so can George Jefferson -- at least that's what George believes.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E6 — Good News, Bad News
An introduction to a friend puts Helen and Louise's friendship on the line -- and George couldn't be happier.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E7 — The Visitors
George and Louise are caught in the line of fire when Florence's battling parents pay the Jefferson household an unexpected and unnerving visit.
